report.title: Aapki report taiyaar hai
report.subtitle: Yahan aapki report ki seedhi-saadhi bhasha mein jaankari di gayi hai.
report.analysis_unavailable_desc: Yeh report nahi mil saki. Ho sakta hai yeh hata di gayi ho ya link galat ho.
report.analysis_failed_desc: CareAI aapki file nahi padh saka. File shayad kharab ho, password se protected ho, ya padhne layak na ho. Kripya ek saaf PDF upload karein.
report.analyzing: Aapki report padhi jaa rahi hai
report.analyzing_desc: CareAI aapki report ko step by step dekh raha hai. Isme usually 10–20 seconds lagte hain.
report.reading: Report kholi aur padhi jaa rahi hai
report.identifying: Kiye gaye tests ki pehchaan ho rahi hai
report.finding: Dhyan dene wale results dhoonde jaa rahe hain
report.preparing: Aapke liye simple summary likhi jaa rahi hai
report.normal_results_desc: Ye results aapki report mein di gayi range ke andar hain.
report.no_results: Is report se koi test result nahi padha jaa saka.
report.questions_heading: Aap apne doctor se yeh sawaal pooch sakte hain
report.questions_extra: Kya mere results mein aur bhi kuch hai jo mujhe jaanna chahiye?
report.cbc_explanation: CBC ek common blood test hai. Isme blood ke alag-alag parts check kiye jaate hain — jaise red blood cells, white blood cells, hemoglobin aur platelets. Doctor ise aapki general health check karne aur anemia, infection jaisi cheezein dekhne ke liye karte hain.
